children: W. P. Carey reported visibility into over $1.9 billion of 2026 investment volume and an improved outlook for tenant credit-related rent loss.
Visibility into more than $1.9B of 2026 investment volume, including ~$1.4B completed year to date and pipeline deals.
Improved 2026 outlook for rent loss after receiving August rent from Hellweg and expecting additional collections in H2 2026.
Bank guarantees expected to cover up to three months of lease-related damages for Hellweg.
Executed leases for nine Hellweg stores (~$9.8M, 64% of Hellweg ABR); new rent to begin late 2026–mid-2027.
Two Hellweg stores (~$1.2M, 8% ABR) near lease signing by end of September; five stores (~$4.3M, 28% ABR) expected to be sold by end of 2026.
